parameters.name: product_set
parameters.description: Set of products indexed over the five listed items A, B, C, D, E

parameters.name: candidate_container_set
parameters.description: Set of candidate containers, with size K

parameters.name: unit_weight
parameters.description: Unit weight of each product in tons

parameters.name: maximum_payload
parameters.description: Maximum payload per used container in tons

parameters.name: minimum_utilized_load
parameters.description: Minimum utilized load per used container in tons

parameters.name: minimum_required_quantity
parameters.description: Minimum required quantity of supporting product for each compatibility rule

parameters.name: per_used_container_minimum
parameters.description: Per-used-container minimum quantity requirement for designated products

variables.name: container_usage
variables.description: Binary indicator equal to 1 if container k is used

variables.name: loaded_quantity
variables.description: Integer quantity of product i loaded into container k

constraints.name: nonnegative_inventory_and_weights
constraints.description: Available quantities must be nonnegative and unit weights must be positive

constraints.name: container_bounds_validity
constraints.description: Container load bounds must be positive and minimum load should not exceed maximum payload

constraints.name: compatibility_thresholds_nonnegative
constraints.description: Compatibility minimum required quantities must be nonnegative

constraints.name: designated_minimums_nonnegative
constraints.description: Per-used-container minimum quantities must be nonnegative for designated products

constraints.name: loaded_quantity_integrality
constraints.description: Loaded quantities must be integer and nonnegative for every product and container

constraints.name: container_usage_binary
constraints.description: Container usage indicators must be binary for every candidate container

constraints.name: nonnegative_container_load
constraints.description: The total load in any container must be nonnegative

constraints.name: inventory_not_exceeded
constraints.description: The total assigned quantity of each product cannot exceed available inventory

constraints.name: unused_container_has_no_load
constraints.description: If a container is not used, then all assigned product quantities in that container must be zero

constraints.name: container_capacity_bounds
constraints.description: For each used container, the total payload must lie within the minimum utilized load and maximum payload bounds
constraints.formula: L y_k \leq \sum_{i \in \mathcal{I}} w_i x_{ik} \leq U y_k \quad \forall k \in \mathcal{K}

constraints.name: compatibility_rule_a_requires_c
constraints.description: If any units of product A are loaded into a container, that same container must also contain at least the required minimum quantity of product C

constraints.name: supporting_product_optional_without_trigger
constraints.description: The supporting product in a compatibility rule may appear even when the trigger product is absent

constraints.name: minimum_d_when_container_used
constraints.description: Every used container must contain at least the designated minimum quantity of product D

constraints.name: all_required_goods_assigned
constraints.description: All available goods are assigned across containers without omission

objectives.name: minimize_used_containers
objectives.description: Minimize the total number of used containers in the packing plan

objectives.name: find_feasible_packing
objectives.description: Find any packing allocation that satisfies all capacity, compatibility, inventory, and product-specific minimum requirements if multiple optimal solutions exist

final_objective.description: Minimize the total number of used containers; the auxiliary scalar variable z^* represents this minimum number and is linked to the binary container-usage variables.
